description: A request for a hosted Suite workspace. Signups through the public API confirm their email with a one-time code; a request created here is taken on the operator's word and processed at once. Either way the owner is invited from the new site and chooses their own password.

fields.description: Where the one-time code and the owner's invite go. Its local part names the owner's account on the site, e.g. sagar.s for sagar.s@acme.example.com.
fields.label: Email

fields.description: The person's name, given to their users in Suite Cloud and on the site.
fields.label: Full Name

fields.description: Names the tenant's site and mail domains, e.g. acme. Lowercase letters, digits and dashes.
fields.label: Label

fields.description: The site's time zone, e.g. Asia/Kolkata. Blank keeps the site's default.
fields.label: Time Zone

fields.description: Pending: waiting for the email code. Verified: the code was correct. Processing: the tenant and its site are being set up. Completed: the site is ready and its owner invited; they choose their password when they accept. Failed: stopped on an error; run Retry. Expired: no code within 24 hours.
fields.label: Status
fields.options:
Pending
Verified
Processing
Completed
Failed
Expired

fields.description: Secret that reads the request's status through the signup API. Handed out once, when the code is verified.
fields.label: Request Key

fields.description: The Suite Tenant created for this request.
fields.label: Tenant

fields.description: The site claimed for the tenant.
fields.label: Suite Site

fields.description: The address the signup came from. Blank for a request created in the desk.
fields.label: IP Address

fields.description: A request still waiting for its code after this expires.
fields.label: Expires At

fields.description: Why the request failed, or why the login details could not be mailed.
fields.label: Error

name: Suite Tenant Request
